qt: to the Commission Stefano Cavedagna (ECR) Subject:

Some parents have complained about a number of nurseries and pre-schools in Bologna apparently reading books on gender identity and rainbow families to children between the ages of zero and six. The children’s families had reportedly neither been informed nor involved. Parents’ right to educate their children according to their own religious, philosophical and educational convictions is protected under Article 14(3) of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU In view of the above, can the Commission answer the following: 1.

Does it consider it compatible with Article 14(3) of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU for public education services to present certain ideas on gender identity and family models to young children, without parents being properly informed and without their involvement?

Can it guarantee that no EU funds (Erasmus+, ESF+, CERV), including as part of the LGBTIQ+ equality strategy, finance projects or materials on these topics aimed at the 06 age group without the informed consent of parents?
